name: Hospitable
description: Hospitable lets agents read properties, reservations, calendars, and transactions, and draft replies to guest messages in the signed-in host account. Each user signs in to their own Hospitable account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which guests check in this week, and at which properties?
Summarize the guest messages that still need a reply.
Draft a reply to the latest guest question about parking.

apps.name: Hospitable
apps.description: Properties, reservations, calendars, and guest messages, over Hospitable's MCP server with browser sign-in.
